messages:
anita: Quick intake — bringing up Orchid-25B (hf:/open/orchid-25b). Decoder-only, rotary RoPE with nonstandard freq scale. Need runtime compatibility + prioritization for: (1) KV cache behavior with long-context workloads, (2) quantization smoke (4-bit / q5 variants), (3) eval regressions vs baseline Saffron-20B on summarization/QA. TL;DR: who's owning runtime smoke, quant, and quality gating?

liam: I can pick up quant smoke. Plan: run GPTQ/q4/q5_1 variants, measure perplexity + token-level divergence vs float16 on our eval set. ETA EOD tomorrow. Any preferred quant config knobs?

anita: thanks @liam. Primary knobs: per-channel scale, clip_threshold=0.02, enable-groupsize=128 for q5_1 experiments. Please log model artifacts with tag orchard/orchid25b/quant-<cfg>.

eva: i'll do KV/rotary stress. Tests to run: long-context (64k) attend + evictions, random prefix reuse, and interleaved streaming. Quick command to run minimal kv smoke locally:

```
# run kv stress (dev node)
python -m infra.runtime_smoke --model open/orchid-25b --ctx 65536 --batch 4 --iterations 200 --track-kv
```

I'll report any mismatch where token generation diverges from HF reference within first 512 tokens.

sam: Suggest priority: 1) runtime smoke (eva), 2) quant baseline (liam), 3) quality gates (dara + anita). Gating heuristic: if summarization ROUGE-L drops >4 points or instruction-following accuracy drops >3% vs saffron-20b baseline, block rollout. Also add cost delta checks (per-token ms and GPU utilization).

dara: I'll own quality evals + regression harness. Will run eval suite: summarization, code-gen small, instruction-following. Upload prompts to /evals/orchid25b/ and include failing examples. ETA 48h.

ci-bot: orch-smoke pipeline started for orchid-25b at 1745302000. Jobs: kv-smoke, quant-smoke-q4, quant-smoke-q5_1, eval-harness.

ci-bot: kv-smoke failed in step 3 — mismatch detected in rotary phase accumulation: first divergence at token 127. Log excerpt: "KV_ROTARY_MISMATCH: layer 10, head 3 — weight indices differ by 1e-2"

anita: noted. @eva can you attach the full mismatch dump? If it's a rotary phase math edge, might be due to frequency scaling or fp16 accumulation. Add to triage board under "rotary-phase-accumulation".

eva: grabbing dumps now. Preliminary guess: our runtime applies legacy RoPE scaling factor for rotary pairs; the model uses scaled-rope with per-head multipliers. I'll diff against HF weights.

liam: if rotary is nonstandard, quant will likely amplify mismatch. I'll pause heavy quant runs until we confirm numeric parity or add a fallback to float16-only for affected layers.

dara: quality note — if we see deterministic phase shift, some instruction-following failures could appear only in long prompts. I'll add long-context tests (8k+) to the harness.

anita: action items captured: 1) eva: KV mismatch dump + HF diff (P0), 2) liam: hold on aggressive quant until rotary parity or add per-layer float fallback (P1), 3) dara: run long-context evals + upload failing cases (P1), 4) ci-bot: rerun orch-smoke with enabled float-fallback flag when posted. I'll create a short runbook and tag owners in the triage issue.

sam: +1 on runbook. Also add metric: "kv-mismatch-rate" (fraction of heads with divergence) so we can track regressions across model brings.

ci-bot: triage issue created: GH#7892 (orchid-25b/rotary-kv-accum). Linked pipelines: orch-smoke-1745302.

anita: thanks everyone. Please ping in this thread when your artifacts are uploaded. If anyone needs infra/GPU time, ping infra-scheduling. :thumbsup:
